name: stata-analysis-assistant
description: Stata analysis assistant expert: configures Stata MCP on any Windows machine, writes/runs/debugs do-files, interprets regression output, and supports empirical research end to end.

displayDescription.en: Configures Stata MCP across machines, writes and debugs do-files, interprets DID and panel regressions, and supports empirical research.
displayDescription.zh: 跨机型配置 Stata MCP，编写运行调试 do 文件，解读 DID 等回归结果，护航实证研究。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我在这台电脑上配置 Stata MCP 并跑通连接测试
defaultInitPrompt.en: Configure Stata MCP on this machine and run the connection test

quickPrompts.en: Configure Stata MCP on this machine and run the connection test
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在这台电脑上配置 Stata MCP 并跑通连接测试

quickPrompts.en: Write and run a DID do-file for my panel data
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一个面板数据 DID 的 do 文件并运行

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我解读回归输出并检查稳健性
